name: Compendium of the Fallen
summary: Sage Truthseeker asks you to recover the Compendium of the Fallen from the Monastery in Tirisfal Glades. It is sought in Thunder Bluff.

sections.title: A Sage's Request
sections.body: The Monastery in Tirisfal Glades is where Sage Truthseeker's requested volume lies. You are to bring the Compendium of the Fallen back to him in Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Who wants the Compendium of the Fallen?
faq.answer: Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff asks you to retrieve the Compendium of the Fallen.

faq.q: Where is the Compendium of the Fallen?
faq.answer: The Compendium of the Fallen is in the Monastery in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Where do I bring the compendium?
faq.answer: Bring the Compendium of the Fallen to Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff.

attribution: In-game quest text: Compendium of the Fallen
